tutorial.introduction: Exit Intent Popup captures leaving visitors with a targeted offer.
content: Choose Trigger Mode: exitintent, delay or scroll.
Set Suppress After Seen to how many days before popup reappears.
Set Image Display Style then upload an image in the editor image area.
Popup content area is fully drag-and-drop — add text, images, buttons, anything.

tutorial.introduction: Any Slider turns any content into a smooth sliding carousel.
content: Set Number of Slides then design each slide freely in the editor.
Each slide is a full content area — add text, images, buttons, anything.
Enable Autoplay and set the interval to control slide speed.
Toggle Show Arrows and Show Dots to control navigation style.

tutorial.introduction: Countdown Timer creates urgency with a live ticking timer.
content: Choose Timer Mode: fixed counts to a date, evergreen counts from first visit.
For fixed mode set Target Date in format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.
For evergreen mode set duration in minutes.

tutorial.introduction: Pricing Table displays 1-4 side-by-side pricing plans with a highlighted Most Popular card.
content: Set Number of Cards to how many plans you need (1-4).
Set Highlighted Card index: 0=first, 1=second, 2=third, 3=fourth.
Add plan name, price, features and button using drag and drop elements.
Customise card and highlighted colors in the style settings groups.

tutorial.introduction: Accordion FAQ lets you display collapsible question and answer sections to save space and improve UX.
content: Set the number of items to match how many FAQ entries you need.
Increment the Unique ID if you place this element more than once on the same page.
Toggle 'Allow Multiple Open' to let visitors expand several items at once, or keep it off for classic single-open behaviour.
Toggle 'Open First Item by Default' to show the first answer expanded when the page loads.
Customise header, body, and border colors in the settings groups to match your site theme.

tutorial.introduction: With Multi Column Blog app, you can convert your blog posts to multi column layout
content: Select the number of columns for blog posts: For example if you select 3 then your blog posts will be shown in 3 columns.
Select whether to expand the posts area or not: True means that blog sidebar will appear under the blog posts.

Select the style of blog posts: If you select 'simple' then blog posts will look as your theme design but if you select 'card' then your blog posts will look like cards with background color and shadow.
Use Custom Card Colors: If true/enabled, it means that your defined card background color and card shadow color will be used. If false/disabled then default colors will be used.
